name: NiubiGEO v0.3 AI Brand Visibility Tracker (GEO)
description: See how AI models describe your brand and competitors, with evidence.

upstream.version: v0.3.3 (commit 6f0eeeb11b4319e845b491a5067d2cfdc8d07b52; image ghcr.io/albert-weasker/niubigeo:v0.3.3, index digest sha256:5950b779edc0de9c3e869cdbbb6166a8053e0e7c209f7d00a8ca680d43c5841f, created 2026-11-03)

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Recommended. OpenRouter key (openrouter.ai/keys) for the workbench and scheduled runs. Empty: connect a key in the browser per session.

PORT.description: Port the workbench listens on; Railway's healthcheck (/health) and the gateway use it.

HOST.description: Bind address. :: listens on IPv4 and IPv6 of the private network (Node is dual-stack).

MONITORING_DATA_DIR.description: Data root on the volume: product data, worker status, pre-upgrade snapshots (backups/).

PRODUCT_DATA_DIR.description: Projects, model settings, runs, raw answers and evidence (JSON files). Keep it inside /app/data.

NIUBIGEO_WORKER_ENABLED.description: Run the scheduling worker for schedules and keyword monitors. Due runs call models and cost API credits; false turns it off.

NIUBIGEO_WORKER_POLL_SECONDS.description: How often the worker looks for due runs, in seconds (10 or more).

NIUBIGEO_VIDEO_ADVISOR_ENABLED.description: true shows upstream's advisor card, a link to the NiubiGEO team's external service. Off by default.

NIUBIGEO_ALLOW_LOCAL_PROVIDERS.description: true allows http and private-network model endpoints, e.g. an Ollama service in this project. Only for trusted users.

NIUBIGEO_SNAPSHOT_KEEP.description: Pre-upgrade snapshots kept in /app/data/backups (a copy is saved when the NiubiGEO version changes). 0 disables them.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between stop signal and kill on redeploy, so a running monitoring cycle can finish.

NIUBIGEO_IMAGE.description: NiubiGEO image used as the build base (tag + digest). Change it and redeploy to upgrade; a snapshot is saved first.

PORT.description: Port the gateway listens on; the public domain and the healthcheck (/healthz) use it.

BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Login password, generated at deploy (16+ characters). Hashed with bcrypt at start. Change and redeploy to rotate.

NIUBIGEO_GATEWAY_SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs the gateway's session cookie (32+ characters). Changing it signs everyone out.

NIUBIGEO_UPSTREAM.description: NiubiGEO on the private network; this gateway is its only public entry point.

NIUBIGEO_URL.description: Open this and log in with BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME and BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.
